description: This Java source file defines a Spring configuration class 'CollateralManagementConfiguration' which registers various service beans related to collateral management in the Fineract project. It sets up dependency injection for services handling client collateral, collateral management, and loan collateral management, with conditions for bean creation if they are missing.

classes.name: CollateralManagementConfiguration
classes.description: This class provides Spring bean configurations for collateral management services within the Fineract platform, enabling dependency injection and conditional bean creation to support collateral-related operations.

methods.name: clientCollateralManagementReadPlatformService
methods.description: Defines a bean for reading client collateral management data, instantiated as 'ClientCollateralManagementReadPlatformServiceImpl' with necessary dependencies.

methods.name: clientCollateralManagementWritePlatformService
methods.description: Defines a bean for writing client collateral management data, instantiated as 'ClientCollateralManagementWritePlatformServiceImpl' with dependencies.

methods.name: collateralManagementReadPlatformService
methods.description: Defines a bean for reading collateral management data, instantiated as 'CollateralManagementReadPlatformServiceImpl'.

methods.name: collateralManagementWritePlatformService
methods.description: Defines a bean for writing collateral management data, instantiated as 'CollateralManagementWritePlatformServiceImpl'.

methods.name: loanCollateralAssembler
methods.description: Creates a 'LoanCollateralAssembler' bean, which helps in assembling loan collateral data with dependencies.

methods.name: loanCollateralManagementReadPlatformService
